scope: Explicit one-hop native linked-table progressive projections through shared adapter and CLI mapping services

checks.command: cargo test --locked -p tablecraft-access --test linked_progressive --test linked_sources --test progressive_source
cargo clippy --locked -p tablecraft-access --lib --test linked_progressive --test linked_sources --test progressive_source -- -D warnings
cargo clippy -p tablecraft-cli --bin tablecraft --test linked_queries --test progressive_queries -j2 --locked --offline -- -D warnings

review: The same explicitly authorized facade is used for binding and execution; stored paths remain inert and canonical target names stay scoped.
Target projected cursors retain selected-value validation, checked EOF, callback budget release and source exclusivity; neither successful nor failed streams publish complete snapshot caches.
Root and targets share native allowances while query/comparison/output retain separate pools; repeated UNION ALL references do not reset budgets.
CLI buffered/streaming controls cover encrypted targets, explicit cached-calculation opt-in and differing root/target field policies.
Late errors retain only completed TSV batches; unmapped/chained targets refuse without publication.
excluded_authoring_attempts: Initial native fixture helpers used mismatched Jet/ACE header magic and expected a different stored table-name case; independent fixture setup was corrected before accepted checks, without weakening runtime checks.
unrun: Original-file linked progressive replay with final frozen executable
